name: BJMC
title: BJMC — Journalism and Mass Communication
intro: The media roadmap: admission, reporting and media papers, internships and career routes in news, digital and PR.

phases.title: Class 11–12 habits
phases.summary: Any stream; read, write and follow current affairs.
points: Read newspapers and watch news analysis to understand reporting styles.
Write regularly: a blog, school newsletter or short reports.
Strengthen English or your main language, since writing is core.
Check eligibility and minimum marks at your target college.

phases.title: Entrance and admission
points: Central universities use CUET-UG; institutions like Symbiosis, Christ and others run their own tests.
Selection often includes a writing test and interview.
IIMC and other institutes admit mostly at postgraduate level.
Compare labs, studio and internship tie-ups.

phases.title: Core papers
phases.summary: Reporting, editing, media law, broadcast and digital media.
points: Year 1: Introduction to Journalism, Communication Theories, Media History and Writing for Media.
Year 2: Reporting and Editing, Radio and TV Production, Photojournalism and Media Law and Ethics.
Year 3: Digital Media, Public Relations, Advertising, Data Journalism and a project or short film.
You work in newsroom labs, studios and student publications.

phases.title: Internships and portfolio
phases.summary: Build a portfolio with real stories.
points: Intern at newspapers, TV channels, digital media, PR firms or agencies.
Publish bylined stories, videos or podcasts and keep clips ready.
Learn video editing, social media and basic data tools.
Build a portfolio website with your best work.

phases.title: Careers and higher study
phases.summary: Journalism, content, PR, advertising and more.
points: Roles: reporter, sub-editor, anchor, producer, content writer, PR executive and social media manager.
Higher study: MA Journalism, PG diplomas at IIMC and other media institutions.
Exams: CUET-PG, UGC NET (Mass Communication) and civil services.
Freelance and creator careers are growing through video, podcasts and newsletters.
